properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 4:34AM PDT until October 22 at 6:45AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...South Central Inyo County in south central California...
San Bernardino County in southern California...

* WHEN...Until 645 AM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Some
low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 433 AM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Stovepipe Wells, Furnace Creek, Panamint Springs, Darwin, Texas
Springs Campground, Homewood Canyon-Valley Wells, Trona, Mesquite
Springs Campground, Scottys Castle and Searles Valley.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 645 AM PDT THIS MORNING
